71e61ffa4b60b9662018.title: Automation QA Engineer
71e61ffa4b60b9662018.description:
About PayPay

PayPay is a FinTech company that has grown to over 76M (as of November 2026) users since its launch in 2018. Our team is hugely diverse with members from over 50 different countries.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realize a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined. We are looking for people who can embrace this challenge, refresh the product at breakneck speed and promote PayPay with professionalism and passion.

※ Please note that you cannot apply or be selected in parallel with PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation.

 

Team Missions

Serving as an autonomous QA organization in Product Group.

  • To improve the overall quality of PayPay products and services
  • To develop PayPay quality standards and best practices
  • To gain trust in quality from PayPay Users and Merchants

Job Description

Main Responsibilities

  • Analyze testing requirements to develop comprehensive test scenarios for various test levels.
  • Design and create detailed test cases that validate conformance to functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Prepare and manage essential test data, tools, and environments for test execution.
  • Execute test cases and scripts, meticulously documenting results.
  • Log, track, and verify defects, ensuring accurate documentation and timely resolution.
  • Collect, organize, and analyze test results to provide thorough reports on all QA activities.
  • Analyze testing outcomes and recommend effective solutions for identified issues.
  • Maintain and update comprehensive test documentation, ensuring coverage for new features and robust regression testing.
  • Support knowledge management and foster collaboration by actively participating in testing discussions and contributing to continuous improvement through lessons learned.
  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for designated modules, providing critical domain knowledge and support to the QA team.
  • Provide guidance and support to junior QA engineers, including onboarding and training.
  • Leverage AI tools such as NotebookLM, Gemini, Cursor AI, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI APIs to accelerate test case design, automation, and exploratory testing.
  • Apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to validate LLM-driven applications, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and robustness.
  • Work with OpenAI keys, LLM models, and MCP server integrations, automating API-based interactions and securing AI workflows.
  • Test and monitor AI/ML systems for issues such as bias, drift, hallucinations, and performance deviations.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in developing, executing, and maintaining automated test cases for mobile applications, web applications, and/or APIs.
  • Proven professional experience with at least one of the following automation frameworks/tools: Appium (for mobile), Selenium (for web), or Rest-Assured (for APIs).
  • Proficient in utilizing Cucumber for defining and executing test cases.
  • Well-versed in Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) tools such as Jenkins, Bitrise, or similar platforms.
  • Basic understanding of microservices architecture and its associated testing challenges.
  • Strong ability to analyze technical requirements, design comprehensive test strategies, and create detailed, effective test cases.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, coupled with a meticulous attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, a team-oriented mindset, and the ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
  • Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools (NotebookLM, Gemini, Cursor AI, GitHub Copilot).
  • Knowledge of OpenAI API usage, key management, embeddings, and LLM integration workflows.
  • Familiarity with MCP server concepts and their integration in test automation pipelines.
  • Understanding of AI system validation techniques, including testing for bias, hallucinations, drift, and robustness.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ISTQB or an equivalent QA certification.
  • Experience working in Agile or other fast-paced development environments.
  • Familiarity with the financial or payments domain is highly desirable.
  • Experience in proposing and standardizing QA processes, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in designing and executing performance tests using tools such as Gatling, wrk, or JMeter.
  • Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration.
  • Experience with bash or other command-line interface (CLI) scripting.
  • Coding experience in building web or mobile-based applications.
  • A strong sense of curiosity and a passion for continuously learning new technologies are definite plusses!

PayPay 5 senses

  • Please refer PayPay 5 senses to learn what we value at work

Working Conditions 

Employment Status

  • Full Time

 

Office Location

  • Hybrid Workstyle
    ※ You will be expected to work in the office, in alignment with organizational guidelines and team objectives.
  • LIFE in JAPAN FACTBOOK 

 

Work Hours

  • Super Flex Time (No Core Time)
  • In principle, 9:00am-5:45pm (actual working hours: 7h45m + 1h break)

Holidays

  • Every Sat/Sun/National holidays (In Japan)/New Year's break/Company-designated Special days

Paid leave

  • Annual leave (up to 14 days in the first year, granted proportionally according to the month of employment. Can be used from the date of hire)
  • Personal leave (5 days each year, granted proportionally according to the month of employment)
    ＊PayPay's own special paid leave system, which can be used to attend to illnesses, injuries, hospital visits, etc., of the employee, family members, pets, etc.

Salary

  • Annual salary paid in 12 installments (monthly)
  • Based on skills, experience, and abilities
  • Reviewed once a year
  • Late overtime allowance

    ※Payroll payment can be changed to digital salary payment “PayPay Paycheck” for an amount set by you

Benefits

  • Social Insurance (health insurance, employee pension, employment insurance and compensation insurance)
  • 401K
  • Translation/Interpretation support
  • VISA sponsor + Relocation support

Other Information:

  • PayPay Inside-Out (Corporate Blog) /JP
  • PayPay Inside-out (Corporate Blog) /ENG
  • PayPay Product Blog /JP
  • PayPay Product Blog /ENG
  • PIVOT動画：【PayPayが仕掛ける金融革命】

08e459837a7c33ceb3e5.description: Quality Assurance EngineerEngineering · Dubai, UAE · Full-time, on-siteWhy this role existsEvery day, thousands of people in the UAE and Saudi Arabia rely on Justlife to get things done at home—cleanings booked, maintenance sorted, life simplified. Behind that simplicity is a quality promise: the service they book works, the app doesn't break, the experience is seamless. When a bug slips to production, someone's day gets harder. When quality breaks down, trust breaks down.This is a hands-on QA role that sits at the heart of scaling Justlife's engineering organisation. We're growing our development team and launching new product lines, which means testing complexity is rising fast. You'll own the quality gate across mobile, web, and backend systems—catching bugs before customers do, working shoulder-to-shoulder with developers to fix root causes, and building the AI-driven testing practices that let us scale without compromise. Your headline metric: “minimising defects that escape to production while identifying and resolving bugs faster as engineering capacity grows.”You'll love this role if you...You think like a detective—you don't just run test cases, you ask "why would this break?" and find the edge cases nobody else seesYou're genuinely curious about AI and automation, and you actively use these tools to work smarter, not just fasterYou thrive in startup chaos and actually enjoy changing priorities, evolving processes, and building things that didn't exist beforeYou believe quality is everyone's job—you push back constructively on vague requirements, challenge assumptions, and help developers ship better codeYou measure yourself by outcomes (bugs caught, speed to resolution, process improvements shipped) not just activityWhat you'll own“Drive defect escape rates down and resolution velocity up” by mastering Justlife's products, designing test scenarios across mobile/web/backend, and investigating root causes that developers can actually fixParticipate in product and technical grooming—be the voice that asks "what could go wrong here?" and identifies risks before development startsCollaborate with our Automation team to expand test coverage, improve regression suites, and identify which tests should be automated versus manualOwn the testing and verification for assigned Scrum commitments—regression, exploratory, integration, and end-to-end testing as neededLeverage AI tools and agents to accelerate test scenario creation, analyse requirements for gaps, and reduce repetitive manual work—then share what you learn with the teamBuild strong working relationships with developers and cross-functional partners (Product, Business, Automation)—be the QA engineer they want in their grooming sessionsIdentify and implement at least one AI-driven QA initiative by month six, measure its impact, and present it to the wider Engineering organisationWhat tells us you're the oneYou've “measurably improved a quality outcome across a real product or service”—tell us about a testing initiative you led, an automation effort you contributed to, or a bug-finding approach you designed that moved a specific metric (defects caught, time-to-resolution, test coverage, automation percentage, whatever matters in your context)You've worked in a startup or fast-paced tech environment and can show us how you adapted to changing priorities and ambiguity without losing ownershipYou have 2+ years of hands-on QA experience with demonstrated strength in test design, bug lifecycle management, and root-cause analysis—we care more about what you've shipped than years on a CVYou've used AI tools practically in your QA or development work (not just read about them)—show us a concrete example of how you applied AI to improve testing, analysis, or productivityYou understand automation concepts and test frameworks (Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or similar)—direct automation coding isn't required, but you speak the language and can collaborate effectively with automation engineersYou work in a startup or complex product environment where you've seen mobile, web, and backend systems interact, and you understand the testing implicationsWhy JustlifeScale and impact: Your testing covers thousands of daily app sessions, multiple platforms (iOS, Android, web), and backend services that power home services across two countries—the quality bar you set affects real people's daysReal growth: You'll move from this role and beyond by owning QA initiatives, building AI-driven practices, and becoming the go-to quality partner for engineering teamsA collaborative culture: You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and automation engineers who actually listen to QA and see quality as shared responsibilityStartup spirit plus stability: birthday day off (JustHoliday), free Justlife credits, referral bonuses, team experiences, and a fair, transparent performance system with recognition through our JustHeroes programJoin the tribe and let's become #everydaybetter, together.
